svg.title: Looming Bursts
svg.desc: A stylized Audacity-like waveform for the PPS-kit burst-train source mode: separate short noise bursts increase in peak amplitude from far and quiet to near and loud.

g.font-family: Aptos, Noto Sans, Helvetica Neue, sans-serif
g.text: Discrete Gaussian noise bursts with a rising approach envelope.
